_comment: Branch protection config applied to dev and main of every MiraNote-AI repo by bin/apply-branch-protection.sh. (1) `restrictions` empty-allowlist applies to main only: there, only admins can push or merge, so main moves only by the owner's dev -> main promotion. The script sends `restrictions: null` for dev, because a restriction also limits who may merge and teammates merge their own approved PRs into dev; (2) `required_status_checks` requires `checks / checks` -- a PR with a red check cannot merge; (3) every PR needs one approving review from someone other than its author, and every review conversation must be resolved before merge; (4) `enforce_admins: false` is deliberate (owner decision, 2026-10-29): admins -- the org owner -- may merge their own PRs without a second reviewer, and are also not held to (2) or (3); everyone else is held to all three, so teammates' PRs still need the owner's approval.
